stories.title: Fort-Hood-Attentäter: Hinrichtung von US-Amokläufer soll live übertragen werden

en.title: Fort Hood Attacker: Execution of US Mass Shooter to Be Broadcast Live
en.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth plans to broadcast live the execution of a man who killed 13 people at a military base in 2009.

stories.title: News: Friedensnobelpreis, Uefa gegen Infantino, Rot-grün-rote Sondierung in Berlin

en.title: News: Nobel Peace Prize, UEFA Against Infantino, Red-Green-Red Exploratory Talks in Berlin
en.summary: The Nobel Peace Prize winner will be announced in Oslo, UEFA searches for an alternative to Infantino across Europe, and exploratory coalition talks begin in Berlin.

stories.title: Festnahme nach tödlichen Schüssen auf zwei Landratsamtmitarbeiter in Bayern

en.title: Arrest Following Fatal Shootings of Two County Office Employees in Bavaria
en.summary: An arrest has been made after two county office workers were shot and killed in Bavaria.

stories.title: Berngau in der Oberpfalz: Festnahme nach tödlichen Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: Berngau in Upper Palatinate: Arrest Following Fatal Shootings During Weapon Inspection
en.summary: Two government employees were shot during a routine weapons inspection in Berngau; the suspect was apprehended after police ended the operation overnight.

stories.title: Vorfall in NEW YORK: ICE-Beamter schießt auf Mann – Kind im Auto

en.title: Incident in NEW YORK: ICE officer shoots at man – child in car
en.summary: An immigration enforcement officer fired at a man in a vehicle containing a five-year-old child in New York. The mayor responded with strong criticism of the incident.

stories.title: Berngau in der Oberpfalz: Zwei Tote nach Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: Berngau in Upper Palatinate: Two dead after shots fired during weapons inspection
en.summary: A man opened fire during a weapons inspection in Berngau, killing two people. The suspected shooter was reportedly barricaded in a residential building with special forces responding to the scene.

stories.title: USA wollen Hinrichtung von Attentäter per Livestream übertragen

en.title: USA plan to broadcast military execution via livestream
en.summary: The United States intends to carry out its first military execution in over 60 years in early December. Defense Secretary Hegseth stated the execution will be public and transmitted via livestream.

stories.title: In Berngau: Festnahme nach tödlichen Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: In Berngau: Arrest after fatal shots fired during weapons inspection
en.summary: Two county office employees were shot and killed during a routine weapons inspection in Upper Palatinate. The suspected shooter was arrested after barricading himself in a residence for hours before police used explosives to breach the building.

stories.title: New York: ICE-Beamte schießen auf Mann in Auto – Kind an Bord

en.title: New York: ICE officers shoot at man in car with child on board
en.summary: US immigration enforcement officers surrounded a vehicle in New York and fired shots, wounding a man apparently with his child present. The city's mayor responded with anger.

stories.title: US to livestream Fort Hood shooter's execution: Pentagon

en.title: US to livestream Fort Hood shooter's execution: Pentagon
en.summary: The US military plans to carry out an execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad and broadcast it publicly. This will be the first military execution by the United States since 1961.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Pentagon will Hinrichtung von Attentäter live übertragen

en.title: USA under Trump: Pentagon will livestream execution of attacker
en.summary: The Pentagon plans to livestream an execution under the Trump administration. Trump has also reduced military exercises with South Korea.

stories.title: Fort Hood: Pentagon plant Livestream der Hinrichtung von Nidal Hasas

en.title: Fort Hood: Pentagon plans livestream of execution of Nidal Hasan
en.summary: Nidal Hasan is scheduled to be executed by military firing squad on December 3, with the US Defense Secretary planning to broadcast the execution live online.

stories.title: Energie: Gegen den Trend: EWE und Verbund planen Wasserstoff-Elektrolyseur in industrieller Dimension

en.title: Energy: Against the trend: EWE and Verbund plan hydrogen electrolyzer at industrial scale
en.summary: Energy company EWE and power generator Verbund are advancing a hydrogen electrolyzer project, offering renewed prospects for the hydrogen market subject to certain conditions.

stories.title: Sicherheit: „Diffamierung und Verleumdung“: China weist Spionage-Warnungen scharf zurück

en.title: Security: "Defamation and slander": China sharply rejects espionage warnings
en.summary: China has accused Germany of spreading inflammatory rhetoric in response to security authority warnings, while German politicians and experts dispute the claims.

stories.title: Geldanlage: So haben 450.000 Deutsche im September investiert

en.title: Investment: How 450,000 Germans invested in September
en.summary: Exclusive broker data reveals various investment trends among German investors in September, with two sectors benefiting unexpectedly.

stories.title: Immobilien: Hier sparen Käufer im Umland von München am meisten

en.title: Real estate: Here buyers save the most in the Munich area
en.summary: Purchasing property outside Munich significantly reduces costs for buyers, with a study identifying where prices are most affordable for commuters and calculating break-even points for longer commutes.

stories.title: Niederfrequenzen: SpaceX fordert US-Mobilfunker heraus – Frequenz-Kauf belastet T-Mobile US & Co

en.title: Low frequencies: SpaceX challenges US mobile carriers – spectrum purchase burdens T-Mobile US & Co
en.summary: SpaceX has advanced its plan to offer mobile connectivity directly from space to smartphones. Shares of competing carriers including T-Mobile US have declined in response.
